title: Detect a full AD license via a technology set
summary: Checks with IServerSecurity.IsTechnologySetSupported whether the running license includes the Schematic_Editor technology set, and lists all technology sets the license reports.
phrasings: check which Altium license is active
is a feature licensed in this session
detect schematic editor license from an extension

commands.name: CheckADLicense
commands.description: Check whether the Schematic_Editor technology set is licensed
commands.params: TechnologySet=<name, default Schematic_Editor>|Server=<server module name, default this extension>

commands.name: ListTechnologySets
commands.description: List the technology sets the license reports (addition)
